title: ethereum/go-ethereum v1.5.5: Doesn't look like anything to me (1.5.5)
summary:
Geth 1.5.5 is a patch release, mostly fixing bugs and annoyances.
The brave soul/sole feature of the release is support for exporting the blockchain to- and importing it from gzipped data streams (#3427) too. This can be useful for private network development purposes to back up and restore snapshot
